title: Managerial and cost accounting
audience: a college student in a finance, accounting or business degree program, or a career changer studying the same material on their own
purpose: Classify costs, compute product costs with job-order, process and activity-based costing, analyze cost-volume-profit, build budgets and variance analyses, and make short-term decisions about pricing, make-or-buy, special orders and capital investments.
primary_reading: OpenStax Principles of Accounting, Volume 2: Managerial Accounting (free)

blocks.deliverable: Compute the cost of three jobs with overhead.
Compare traditional and activity-based product costs.
Week 7 midterm; build a quarterly master budget.
Rank three projects by payback and net present value.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Cost and budget study: for a described manufacturer, compute product costs two ways, build a master budget, analyze last quarter's variances, and recommend one pricing or product-mix decision in a two-page memo with supporting schedules.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
